tools.name: route_chat
tools.description: Send a chat completion through Conduit Router: policy-checked, budget-checked, metered, and audit-receipted. Uses your own stored provider keys (BYOK). Pin a model as "provider:model" or let your standing terms choose.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: The public model catalog: every model the router can serve, with provider, free-tier flag, task profiles, and pricing source/as-of.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Your cumulative meter (requests, tokens, provider cost, router charge), today's spend against your daily budget, and which providers you have keys stored for.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: One of your calls' audit receipts (id like "rcpt_12") with its hash-chain proof: record hash validity, successor linkage, and the current chain head.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Cryptographically verify a receipt record (yours or anyone's) against the router's audit chain: the record hash must recompute and the stored record at that sequence must match.

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: Your key's standing terms (mandate): task profile, per-request and daily budgets, model allowlist, fallback chain, region — plus kill-switch state.
